POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Kiran Patel | Age: 54
Body Temperature at Scene: 25.5°C | Ambient Temperature: 25.1°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 4.6 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  2. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  3. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
